title_original: Andrew Garfield and Gabrielle Union Attend Ferragamo Dinner in Beverly Hills and More Red Carpet Photos: October 2026
excerpt_original: October began with Ben Affleck and Kerry Washington premiering “Animals,” their new political thriller about a Los Angeles mayoral candidate (Affleck) whose family is thrust into an unimaginable situation involving their son and housekeeper and her undocumented immigrant…

blocks.text: October began with Ben Affleck and Kerry Washington premiering “Animals,” their new political thriller about a Los Angeles mayoral candidate (Affleck) whose family is thrust into an unimaginable situation involving their son and housekeeper and her undocumented immigrant boyfriend.

links.text: Ben Affleck and Kerry Washington premiering “Animals,”

blocks.text: The following day, the Critics Choice Association hosted its sixth annual Celebración of Cinema & Television in Beverly Hills. John Leguizamo delivered a tear-filled acceptance speech when he was presented with the Career Achievement Award.

links.text: John Leguizamo delivered a tear-filled acceptance speech

blocks.text: In New York City, Pedro Pascal walked the red carpet at the New York Film Festival for the world premiere of his Tony Gilroy -directed drama “Behemoth!”
Take a look at the best red carpet and event photos so far from October 2026 below. Keep checking back all month long for more.
